reconcile.note: Gill notes the next village welcomed Jesus, showing the hostile reception at one Samaritan town was not representative of Samaritans generally.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists this as a straightforward contradiction, since Luke's village refuses Jesus while John's Samaritans eagerly receive him.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: They didn't receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.
sides.verseText: They didn't receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.

sides.snippet: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
sides.verseText: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
